summary: Implemented rich_measure for Tree and rich.align.VerticalCenter in the generated repo. Changes: rich/tree.py adds an iterative __rich_measure__ (imports Measurement); rich/align.py adds VerticalCenter, reprs for Align and VerticalCenter, and the Align width constraint (measured maximum, or min with explicit width); rich/console.py sets justify="default" in render options for print; CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 unreleased with an Added section listing both entries; tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py gained the specified tests. Tests were not run (per instructions); the expected outputs were verified by reading only. Nothing committed.
